claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and tit-rate weaning per spontaneous breathing trial readiness.
Continue propofol and fentanyl sedation titrated to goal RASS -1, reassessing sedation and delirium (CAM-ICU) status.
Obtain serial arterial blood gases to monitor severe metabolic acidosis and lactate clearance.
Continue intravenous sodium bicarbonate therapy for severe metabolic acidosis with bicarbonate 14 mEq/L and base excess -9 to -12.
Monitor coagulation parameters (PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen, platelets) given INR 1.8-2.0, fibrinogen 100-216 mg/dL, and platelets 60-80 K/uL.

Continue enteral/parenteral nutrition support and monitor albumin (2.7-2.9 g/dL) and nutrition status.
Perform daily assessment for ICU-acquired weakness and delirium with CAM-ICU and Richmond-RAS.
Monitor hemodynamics (heart rate, arterial blood pressure, central venous pressure) given tachycardia and borderline blood pressure.
Provide pressure injury prevention with repositioning and skin care for Braden-identified risk and existing impaired skin area.
